record.body:
## Rationale

A committed api-types.ts shows type changes in review diffs. The Node web job stays free of Python, and a Python CI job checks that the file is current.

## Counter-argument

A committed generated file can go stale between commits, and the sync check adds a CI step. Build-time generation never goes stale.

payload.alternatives: generate the types at build time
payload.choice: Commit api-types.ts from openapi-typescript and check sync in Python CI
